what: A magnifier of radius 24px sits at the bottom right (40px from the right · 132px from the bottom). When held it grows to radius 128px (spring stiffness 150 · damping .9), keeps the grabbed spot and follows the cursor (stiffness 520 · damping .72). On release it slides back to the corner at stiffness 70 · damping .92. Only the hidden note inside the glass (.895 of the radius) is revealed by a mask, and pressing the center of the note while holding counts as found (is-found + fx:found).

options.dock-x · dock-y: Placement — distance from the right and bottom of the screen (px), default 40 · 132
options.r · held-r: Radius (px) when released · when held, default 24 · 128
options.k · z: Spring stiffness and damping on return, default 70 · .92
options.k-held · z-held: Spring stiffness and damping when grabbed and dragged, default 520 · .72
options.glass: Shining circle = Radius × this value, default .895
options.[data-fx-part=secret]: Notes visible only inside the glass (several). When found, is-found is added and an fx:found event fires on the element

note: The magnifier is a fixed element attached to body. The original carries a 3D magnifier built with three (metal rim, 72 ticks, red-band handle) and shows a 1.6x copy of the page inside the circle. This part carries over only that feel (spring values, keeping the grip spot, finding hidden notes) as a CSS magnifier

from.where: All pages — carry the hero 3D magnifier around to find 15 hidden handwritten notes (n/15 found at bottom right)
